news.summary: Anthropic 本周向美國證券交易委員會遞交S-1招股說明書，文件顯示，Anthropic預計未來十年在雲服務、計算能力和基礎設施方面至少承諾支出5180億美元，其中約八成不可取消或無論實際使用量如何都需要支付，市場對於AI資本支出的不確定性大幅降低。法人看好，這將有利於鴻海（2317）、廣達（2382）、緯創（3231）、緯穎（6669）等主力供應商長期正向發展。

news.title: 不止6檔老AI股！ 輝達黃仁勳喊「產能瓶頸」欽點3台廠擴產
news.summary: 輝達（NVIDIA）宣布攜手全球供應鏈擴大AI製造產能，在公布的供應鏈背板中，除了包含台達電（2308）、技嘉（2376）、緯創（3231）、和碩（4938）、鴻海（2317）旗下鴻佰科技及廣達（2382）旗下雲達科技等6家台灣廠商外，台廠京元電（2449）、欣興（3037）及矽品均入列。其中，輝達將向京元電提供11億美元產能預約預付款，支援在美國建置測試廠房及設備，目標2027年4月進入大量生產；另透過欣興擴充台灣載板產能，並與矽品合作大幅增加共同封裝光學（CPO）所需的光引擎產能。 《詳全文...》
news.title_en: Not just 6 old AI stocks! NVIDIA's Jensen Huang calls 'capacity bottleneck' and endorses 3 Taiwanese factories to expand production.
news.summary_en: NVIDIA announces collaboration with global supply chain to expand AI manufacturing capacity. In the disclosed supply chain backplane, besides including Delta Electronics （2308）, Gigabyte （2376）, Wistron （3231）, Pegatron （4938）, Foxconn （2317） subsidiary Foxconn Interconnect Technology and Quanta （2382） subsidiary CloudTech, totaling 6 Taiwanese manufacturers, Taiwanese companies Chin Yuan Electric （2449）, Unimicron （3037） and Siliconware are also listed. Among them, NVIDIA will provide USD 1100000000 capacity reservation prepayment to Chin Yuan Electric, supporting the construction of test factories and equipment in the US, targeting 2027 year 4 month to enter mass production; also through Unimicron expanding Taiwan substrate capacity, and cooperating with Siliconware to significantly increase optical engine capacity required for co-packaged optics (CPO). 《Read full article...》

news.title_en: Nvidia's advanced packaging major transformation: interposer becomes key strategic material; UMC, Powerchip become red-hot picks
news.summary_en: Nvidia's advanced packaging major transformation, announces development of new 'Optical Integration on Interposer' (OOI) technology, already has prototype samples, using larger area interposer to replace current organic packaging substrate, and moving optical engine directly to interposer where compute chips reside. This will make interposer a new key strategic material for AI, UMC （2303）, Powerchip （6770） become red-hot picks.

news.title_en: Not just 6 old AI stocks! NVIDIA's Jensen Huang calls 'capacity bottleneck' and endorses 3 Taiwanese factories to expand production.
news.summary_en: NVIDIA announces collaboration with global supply chain to expand AI manufacturing capacity. In the disclosed supply chain backplane, besides including Delta Electronics （2308）, Gigabyte （2376）, Wistron （3231）, Pegatron （4938）, Foxconn （2317） subsidiary Foxconn Interconnect Technology and Quanta （2382） subsidiary CloudTech, totaling 6 Taiwanese manufacturers, Taiwanese companies Chin Yuan Electric （2449）, Unimicron （3037） and Siliconware are also listed. Among them, NVIDIA will provide USD 1100000000 capacity reservation prepayment to Chin Yuan Electric, supporting the construction of test factories and equipment in the US, targeting 2027 year 4 month to enter mass production; also through Unimicron expanding Taiwan substrate capacity, and cooperating with Siliconware to significantly increase optical engine capacity required for co-packaged optics (CPO). 《Read full article...》

items.summary: 力成（6239）董事長蔡篤恭今日在法說會上指出，公司的經營理念與策略定位透過不斷的技術研發，提供客戶最好的封測解決方案。優先服務半導體產品或系統模組公司，也已持續發展高階。力成統計，先進封裝營收拉升至三成，公司不再依賴傳統記憶體經濟循環。

items.title: 力成法說會／預期2027年記憶體市場供需趨穩定 需求仍大於供給
items.summary: 力成（6239）27日召開法說會，公司團隊回應提問指出，市場供需預期 2027 年記憶體市場供需將趨於穩定，且需求仍大於供給。至於中國大陸擴產優先滿足當地市場，對力成不會有負面影響；同時在 AI 應用蓬勃發展下，相關封裝產業成長動能應可持續。

items.title: 力成法說會／第4季續樂觀 董座：客戶陣容與開發名單已擴至 CSP 等
items.summary: 力成（6239）董事長蔡篤恭27日在法說會上指出，力成的客戶陣容與開發名單已進一步擴展至 AI 晶片的雲端服務供應商（CSP）等。從傳統封裝轉向面板級基礎設施與先進研發，公司積極擴建FOPLP、3DIC 與 CPO 等高階設備。為釋放資金與工程研發量能以全力投入先進封裝，力成透過整頓成熟且毛利率較低的海外資產（例如調整中國大陸傳統封裝廠的股權結構）來精簡營運架構，將投資重心全面聚焦於台灣的高階先進製程據點。

news.summary: PCB族群東南亞布局推進，其中泰國最多廠包含臻鼎-KY（4958）、欣興（3037）、金像電（2368）、華通（2313）、台虹（8039）、聯茂（6213）、台燿（6274）、騰輝電子-KY（6672）都已布局卡位，至於馬來西亞封測供應鏈優勢，台光電（2383）、精成科（6191）也已插旗，金居（8358）近期並已宣布設廠投資。

news.summary_en: PCB group Southeast Asia layout advances, with Thailand having the most factories including Zhen Ding Technology-KY（4958）, Xinxing Electronics（3037）, Kinpo Electronics（2368）, Huatong（2313）, Taihong（8039）, Lianmao（6213）, Taiyao（6274）, Tenghui Electronics-KY（6672） all having positioned themselves; regarding Malaysia's packaging and testing supply chain advantage, Taiguang Optoelectronics（2383）, Jingcheng Technology（6191） have also planted flags, and Jinju（8358） recently announced factory investment.

ai_commentary_en.summary:
Taiwan market mixed as semiconductors face technical headwinds while financials and select tech names show resilience amid institutional rotation.

Taiwan market mixed with semiconductor and components weak on foreign selling while financials and AI supply chain attract rotation. Major indexes testing key moving averages amid geopolitical uncertainty. Selective opportunities in AI server beneficiaries and financial consolidation plays but broad momentum fragile with overbought defensive names vulnerable to profit-taking.

Tech sectors mixed: semiconductors and components see foreign selling despite gains; financials attract strong foreign buying; plastics cool.

Taiwan market shows sector rotation: tech hardware (PCB, AI server supply chain) and financials draw institutional interest despite mixed momentum. Foreign capital favors financial holdings and ODMs, while semiconductor sees selling. Power supplies face headwinds; edge AI and PCB capacity expansion narratives drive selective strength amid broader consolidation.

Taiwan market shows sector rotation with tech and financials leading; biotech, shipping, petrochemicals gain on fundamentals; AI infrastructure spending boosts ODM outlook; risk from overbought financials and foreign selling in semiconductors.

Taiwan equities show sector divergence: financials and semiconductors lead with strong foreign inflows, while panel and shipping stocks face mixed momentum despite institutional support. AI supply chain names attract speculative interest, but overbought technicals warrant caution. Selective accumulation persists in names with structural catalysts.

Taiwan equities show sector divergence: electronic components and semiconductors lead gains despite foreign selling, while steel and financials attract institutional buying. Memory and PCB names face technical headwinds amid AI supply-chain optimism. Selective rotation favors domestically driven cyclical over export-dependent tech.

Taiwan market shows AI-driven tech strength with semiconductors and components leading gains, while financials and consumer staples lag. Foreign capital rotates into AI supply chain and defensive financials, but sells panels and selected tech. Mixed breadth suggests selective opportunities amid macro uncertainty.

Taiwan equities show mixed leadership with semiconductors and electronic components rallying strongly while financials lag despite heavy foreign buying. Foreign investors sold semiconductor and component shares aggressively but accumulated banks and cement. Technical breadth remains constructive above rising moving averages, yet OBV divergences and elevated short interest in select names warrant caution. Watch for foreign flow reversal in tech and MSCI rebalancing impacts on financials.

Taiwan market shows sector divergence: Other Electronics leads with foreign inflows while Semiconductors and Components rally despite foreign selling. Among analyzed names, AI-power and foldable themes drive sharp gains in Silitech and Fushida, but momentum divergences and chip distribution warrant caution. Most names flash mixed signals, suggesting selective holding over broad chasing.

Taiwan equities show mixed rotation with semiconductors and components leading gains despite foreign selling. The ETF sector cools as 0050 slips below key moving averages with institutional distribution of 122.5k shares over five sessions. Foreign outflows of 140.8k shares contrast with trust and dealer support. Technical deterioration warrants caution across broad market exposure.
